set.title: Settings
set.what: How keyward behaves on this computer
set.lockHint: Keys are forgotten and agent sockets dropped. Counted from the last time the vault was used.
set.lockAction.lockHint: Keys are forgotten, the login token stays — only the master password is needed.
set.lockAction.logoutHint: The account logs out entirely: tokens reset, a full login on return. Touch ID and PIN stay.
set.clipboardHint: Passwords and codes are cleared unless replaced. Usernames and card expiry stay: they get pasted more than once.
set.touchIdLaunch: Ask for Touch ID on launch
set.touchIdSecretsHint: The socket already hands passwords only to the signed keyward window. This is on top: a touch for every reveal and copy, with the same trust window.
set.graceHint: How long after a successful Touch ID we stay quiet. Reset when the vault locks.
set.hideOnCopyHint: Copy something and the window gets out of the way, like Bitwarden.
set.iconsHint: Icons come from the same server as the vault. Turn this off to avoid even those requests.
set.keepInDock: Keep in the Dock when closed
set.keepInDockHint: On — the icon stays in the Dock after the close button. Off — it leaves the Dock with the window and comes back when the window opens.
set.keepInTrayHint: The close button hides the window into the menu bar. When this and “Keep in the Dock” are both off, the close button quits the app, agent included.
set.startOnLoginHint: The daemon always starts on its own — this is about the window.
set.screenCaptureHint: By default the window is black in screenshots, screen recordings and Zoom sharing.
set.readFailed: The settings could not be read: {reason}
verb.acct.staysPassword: The master password stays as it is
verb.acct.pinShort: The PIN takes at least 4 characters
verb.acct.touchOn.title: Turn on Touch ID
verb.acct.touchOn.lede: The vault will open with a touch instead of the master password on this computer.
verb.acct.touchOn.s2sub: In the keychain, reachable only with a fingerprint
verb.acct.touchOff.title: Turn off Touch ID
verb.acct.touchOff.lede: The vault will open only with the master password or the PIN again.
verb.acct.touchOff.s1: Forget the key behind the sensor
verb.acct.touchOff.s2sub: Items and the PIN are untouched
verb.acct.pin.title: Set a PIN
verb.acct.pin.lede: A short code instead of the master password on this computer. Five wrong tries in a row reset it.
verb.acct.pin.s1sub: A PIN is set only with it
verb.acct.pin.s2: Encrypt it with a key made from the PIN
verb.acct.pin.s2sub: And keep it on this computer only
verb.acct.pinOff.title: Clear the PIN
verb.acct.pinOff.lede: The vault will no longer open with the PIN on this computer.
verb.acct.pinOff.s1sub: The one locked with the PIN's key
verb.acct.pinOff.s2sub: Items and Touch ID are untouched
set.biometric.on: The master password is kept behind the sensor in the keychain.
set.biometric.off: Opens only with the master password or the PIN.
set.pin.on: Five wrong tries in a row reset it.
set.pin.off: A short code instead of the master password on this computer.
ext.noneHint: Try a passkey in the browser: the extension shows up here with its five words
ext.failed: The extensions could not be read: {reason}
pair.title: Pair a browser
pair.body: A browser extension asks to use your passkeys. Check that its window shows these same words:
pair.expired: The words have expired: try the passkey in the browser again
verb.acct.export.title: Export the vault
verb.acct.export.lede: Bitwarden JSON: imports back losslessly, including custom fields and folders.
verb.acct.export.ledeCsv: Bitwarden CSV: logins and notes; cards and identities keep only name and notes.
verb.acct.export.s2sub: Personal and organisation items; the file gets 0600 permissions
verb.acct.export.warnSub: Every password is in it in plain text. Delete it when you are done.
verb.acct.export.staysVaultSub: An export only reads the items
verb.acct.export.unknown: No such format: JSON or CSV
set.exportHint: Unencrypted JSON or CSV in Bitwarden's format — for moving or a backup.
